// typedecl: program-declared struct types built with reflect.StructOf:
// composite literal, field read and write, var zero value, forward
// reference between declarations, and json output shaped by field order.
type Point struct {
	X int64
	Y int64
}
p := Point{X: 3, Y: 4};
assert.Equal(tb, 3, p.X);
p.X = 5;
assert.Equal(tb, 5, p.X);

q := &Point{X: 1};
assert.Equal(tb, 1, q.X);

var w Point;
w.Y = 7;
assert.Equal(tb, 7, w.Y);

// A declaration can name one written after it, as in Go.
type Wrap struct {
	Inner Base
	M int64
}
type Base struct { N int64 }
b := Wrap{Inner: Base{N: 3}, M: 4};
assert.Equal(tb, 3, b.Inner.N);
assert.Equal(tb, 4, b.M);

// The declared field order shapes the encoder's output; Point carries
// no tags, so the keys are the field names.
buf := bytes.NewBufferString("");
json.NewEncoder(buf).Encode(Point{X: 1, Y: 2});
assert.Equal(tb, "{\"X\":1,\"Y\":2}\n", buf.String());
